```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(uwot)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(FlowSOM)
library(pheatmap)

data_dir <- "/Data/Input/SpectralFlow_FromOpe"

files <- list.files(
  path = data_dir,
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

files
length(files)
```

```{r}
flow_df <- purrr::map_dfr(files, function(f) {
  
  file_base <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))
  
  sample_id <- stringr::str_extract(file_base, "Sample\\d+")
  group <- stringr::str_extract(file_base, "Ctrl|CBD")
  
  read.csv(f, check.names = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      sample_id = sample_id,
      group = group,
      file_name = basename(f)
    )
})

# Check import
dim(flow_df)
table(flow_df$sample_id, flow_df$group)
colnames(flow_df)
```

```{r}
marker_cols <- c(
  "PD1",
  "CD44",
  "CTLA4",
  "CD3",
  "CD4",
  "CD62L",
  "KI67",
  "CD8",
  "NK11",
  "FOXP3"
)

# Check that all markers exist
setdiff(marker_cols, colnames(flow_df))
```

```{r}
marker_cols_umap <- c(
  "CD4",
  "CD8",
  "NK11",
  "FOXP3"
)

setdiff(marker_cols_umap, colnames(flow_df))
```

```{r}
flow_clean <- flow_df

for (m in marker_cols) {
  
  low_cut  <- quantile(flow_clean[[m]], 0.001, na.rm = TRUE)
  high_cut <- quantile(flow_clean[[m]], 0.999, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  flow_clean[[m]] <- pmin(
    pmax(flow_clean[[m]], low_cut),
    high_cut
  )
}

flow_trans <- flow_clean

cofactor <- 5

flow_trans[marker_cols] <- asinh(
  flow_trans[marker_cols] / cofactor
)

flow_trans[marker_cols_umap] <- scale(
  flow_trans[marker_cols_umap]
)
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)

cells_per_sample <- 5000

flow_ds <- flow_trans %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    n_keep <- min(cells_per_sample, nrow(.x))
    slice_sample(.x, n = n_keep)
  }) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)

umap_mat <- uwot::umap(
  as.matrix(flow_ds[, marker_cols_umap]),
  n_neighbors = 75,
  min_dist = 0.6,
  metric = "euclidean",
  verbose = TRUE
)

flow_umap <- flow_ds %>%
  mutate(
    UMAP_1 = umap_mat[, 1],
    UMAP_2 = umap_mat[, 2]
  )
```

```{r}
fsom_mat <- flow_ds %>%
  select(all_of(marker_cols_umap)) %>%
  as.matrix()

set.seed(123)

fsom <- FlowSOM::FlowSOM(
  fsom_mat,
  colsToUse = seq_len(ncol(fsom_mat)),
  xdim = 8,
  ydim = 8,
  nClus = 5,
  scale = FALSE
)

cell_to_node <- fsom$map$mapping[, 1]

flow_umap$cluster <- factor(fsom$metaclustering[cell_to_node])
```

```{r}
ggplot(flow_umap,
       aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, color = cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.15, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
```
```{r}
ggplot(flow_umap,
       aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, color = sample_id)) +
  geom_point(
    size = 0.12,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
```

```{r}
ggplot(flow_umap,
       aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, color = FOXP3)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.15, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
```
